Folio's offline OCR dependencies (unmodified upstream distributables)

Tesseract.js 6.0.1 — https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js
Apache License 2.0. See LICENSE-TesseractJS.txt and worker.min.js.LICENSE.txt
(third-party notices for the distributed worker's bundled dependencies).

Tesseract.js-core 6.1.2 — https://github.com/naptha/tesseract.js-core
Apache License 2.0; see LICENSE-Core.txt. The distributed LSTM-only JS files
contain their own WebAssembly. Only the CPU-appropriate file is loaded.

English, Russian and Kazakh data — https://github.com/naptha/tessdata
Compressed 4.0.0_best_int integerized models from @tesseract.js-data/eng,
@tesseract.js-data/rus, @tesseract.js-data/kaz, each at version 1.0.0.
Upstream model source: https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_best
Apache License 2.0; see LICENSE-Models.txt and LICENSE-Data-Packaging.txt.
The npm package wrappers also declare MIT; their author/license metadata are
retained in the three adjacent *-package.json files. No model was retrained.

Comic-only Japanese (horizontal and vertical) and Korean models:
tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast 4.1.0, https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast/tree/4.1.0
Apache License 2.0; original LICENSE is LICENSE-Tessdata-Fast.txt.
Data contents are unmodified; compressed locally using gzip -n -9.
